messages:
maria.liu: Quick note - pharos-v1 (q5.0) on staging shows mixed-script corruption when translating zh->ar in small smoke. Short repro below, consistent across requests. Anyone free?

devon: paste the minimal input + tokenizer version and qconfig.

maria.liu: Repro: 
`Input: Translate to Arabic: 今天天气很好 — مرحبا بالعالم`
Model: pharos-v1-q5, tokenizer: pharos-tokenizer-2026-02-28, qconfig: q5-default.yaml
Actual output: "مرحبا اليوم ن ح ن  — 今 天 天 気" (CJK emitted as spaced subtokens injected into Arabic stream)

anna: That looks like detok or merges.json pruning. Did the quant calibration change merges?

kevin: I diffed tokenizers: new tokenizer has ZWNJ handling tweak and a "merge_prune_threshold=3" applied during calibration. Also a "normalize_nfkd" flag flipped.

triage-bot: nightly-eval/pharos_q5: multilang-detok BLEU delta -2.7 vs baseline (2026-03-18). Fail locales: zh, ar. Testset: opus-mixed-5k.

maria.liu: I've uploaded tokenizer.json, merges.json, and qconfig to INF-1510 and added failing examples. Blocking a customer smoke.

devon: Temporary mitigation: pin tokenizer to prod:v2 and rerun quant without pruning. If that passes, we bisect merges pruning. I'll kick that off.

ops-bot: job requeued: quant-run-2948765432 (no-prune)

maria.liu: Thanks all, will update ticket INF-1510 with the new run outputs. Appreciate help! :pray:
